extension.summary: Super-VCR Mono, a pixel font from the on-screen display of a VCR
extension.description: Super-VCR Mono by ASmolBoy, a pixel font based on the on-screen displays of VHS players. Skins and add-ons can use it by name: supervcrmono24, supervcrmono36, supervcrmono40, supervcrmono48, supervcrmono60 and supervcrmono72. Sizes that are a multiple of 12 keep its pixels square.
